skill_name: Outline an argument for why online education should be encouraged.
workflow: One argument for why online education should be encouraged is that it is more accessible to those who may not have the opportunity to attend in-person classes. It can also be a more economical option, as students save money on travel expenses, room and board fees, and other related costs. Additionally, the flexibility of online education means that it is tailored to the individual needs and learning styles of the student.
